verdict.rationale: Endpoint paths show versioned APIs (e.g. /api/v3/... and the separate /v2 reference docs). However, the pack contains no versioning policy or deprecation policy, so only the versioning half of the story is implied. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy with timelines and notice, an explicit versioning scheme or policy page, and a changelog or migration guidance between v2 and v3.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
